description:
My first love, who helped me find my dream, turned out to be my shy anti-fan. Yet I can't bring myself to hate him... Why is that? The drama they starred in together as child actors, *Once Upon a Winter*, and the affectionate Tae-Won were Yi-Hyeon's first love and his entire world. Holding onto his words that she might be good as a singer, Yi-Hyeon became an idol and reunites with Tae-Won upon hearing news of *Once Upon a Winter 2*'s production. But behind his gentle smile, Tae-Won seems somehow hollow. The moment he chased after him to stop his sudden departure he witnessed Tae-Won inside an open car with a strange man.

 *“Need someone to play along? Then keep filming, hyung. I'll do it.”*

As the plot twists into an increasingly complex mess,Yi-Hyeon and Tae-Won's relationship becomes tangled too...!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
